report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-350ms durations; logs show no errors and metrics show zero 502s. The alert's gateway observations are healthy, so no bounded root cause is established. The single 344ms sample and a 425ms p95 are not sufficient to claim downstream latency, and no dependency, pool, or memory evidence supports a fault.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms/425ms p95 is anomalous
Per-dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize any slowness
Error-rate or timeout metrics for downstream services over the incident window
Confirmation of whether the alert threshold was breached and by which signal
